text: Q2 2026 revenue was $925 million, up 18% from $781 million in Q2 2025.
Q2 2026 net income was $55 million compared to $6 million in Q2 2025, an increase of 817%.
Q2 2026 diluted earnings per share was $0.14 compared to $0.01 in Q2 2025.
Q2 2026 adjusted net income was $128 million, up 73% year-over-year from $74 million.
Q2 2026 adjusted EPS was $0.32, up 88% year-over-year from $0.17.
Q2 2026 EBITDA was $157 million, up 441% year-over-year from $29 million.
Q2 2026 adjusted EBITDA was $184 million, up 116% year-over-year from $85 million.
Net new bookings in Q2 2026 were $69 million, up 3% from Q1 2026.
CoStar delivered its 61st consecutive quarter of double-digit revenue growth in Q2 2026.
Operating cost growth was held to 2% in Q2 2026.
The residential segment turned adjusted EBITDA positive in Q2 2026 with a $41 million improvement from Q1 2026.
Homes.com Ai was launched in February 2026.
Apartments.com Ai was introduced in June 2026 and generated more than half a million AI sessions within weeks.
Apartments.com Ai users averaged 20-minute sessions, 2.8 times longer than non-AI users.
Apartments.com Ai users viewed twice as many listings as non-AI users.
3D tour usage increased 224% among Apartments.com Ai users.
Traffic-to-lead conversion increased 256% among Apartments.com Ai users.
CoStar Rent Benchmark was launched, built from four million AI-abstracted lease agreements.
CoStar entered the France market in Q2 2026.
The company reduced its projected expense base by roughly $100 million versus original guidance.
Full-year 2026 adjusted EBITDA guidance is affirmed at $780 million to $820 million.
Q3 2026 adjusted EBITDA guidance is $190 million to $210 million, representing 21% margin at midpoint.
Full-year 2026 revenue guidance was revised to $3.715 billion to $3.755 billion, representing approximately 15% year-over-year growth at midpoint.
Q3 2026 revenue guidance is $935 million to $945 million, representing approximately 13% year-over-year growth at midpoint.
Full-year 2026 adjusted EPS guidance is reaffirmed at $1.32 to $1.39 based on 405 million shares.
